title: Teri Bhain Nay Taanga Rakhian Nay
body:
Teri bhain nay taanga rakhian nay veerna karbal wassan waleya…
<<DIVIDER>>
Saani)
Menu shakal wikha ja murr watna Tay aaja satween nu aan waleya karbal wassan waleya..
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Jewain sehray tu maut day laye karbal day veera janglaan wich
Lutiyaan gaeyaan jokkaan teeraan diyan nokaan gardan Tay khaan waleya karbal wassan waleya….
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra )
Baad teray nay qaidian wangu din zindagi day paye guzarday nay
Mehmal toun laha Kay wass rahwan day pa Kay Chad menu jaanr waleya karbal wassan waleya…
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Aeho ehsas veer khanda aay hondi amri jay meri kol meray
Dukh wand di oh meray kol khardi oh teray saanjaan mukanr waleya karbal wassan waleya…
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Meri akhiyan ch veer wasda aay pak baqiya teri udeekaan da
Sunr meriyan arzaan wadh gaeyaan nay marzaan chithian na panr waleya karbal wassan waleya…
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra )
Bibi sughra Samar aay kehndi aay roz khaaban ch veer Akbar nu
Mar jawaan Tay aaween meri lash nu dafnaween rah Tay bithaanr waleya karbal wassan waleya….
